content: Rifabutin reduces the plasma levels of dabrafenib by inducing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme metabolism. It is recommended to avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of daridorexant through its effect on CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels and therapeutic effects of darifenacin by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative therapy. Rifabutin decreases the levels and effects of darolutamide via mechanisms involving CYP3A4 and P-gp substrates. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Darolutamide is a substrate of P-gp and CYP3A4; avoid combining it with strong or moderate inducers of these pathways. Rifabutin lowers the levels and efficacy of darunavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Conversely, darunavir increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of dasatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of deflazacort by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Deflazacort should not be coadministered with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin reduces the levels of deuruxolitinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly reduce deuruxolitinib exposure, and coadministration is not recommended. Rifabutin decreases the levels and effects of dexamethasone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and efficacy of diazepam by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and effects of dihydroergotamine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and efficacy of intranasal dihydroergotamine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and effects of dronedarone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and efficacy of duvelisib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers decrease duvelisib exposure, potentially reducing its efficacy. Efavirenz decreases the levels and effects of rifabutin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and efficacy of elacestrant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and effects of eletriptan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and efficacy of eliglustat by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly decrease eliglustat exposure, and coadministration is not recommended. Rifabutin decreases the levels and effects of elvitegravir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels and efficacy of encorafenib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin decreases the levels and effects of entrectinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels and efficacy of enzalutamide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. If coadministration is unavoidable, increase the enzalutamide dose from 160 mg to 240 mg daily. Once the CYP3A4 inducer is discontinued, revert to the original enzalutamide dose. Rifabutin decreases the levels and effects of erdafitinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and efficacy of ergotamine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and effects of erlotinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and efficacy of erythromycin base by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Erythromycin base increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting its metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Erythromycin ethylsuccinate increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting its metabolism. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of erythromycin ethylsuccinate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Erythromycin lactobionate increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting its metabolism. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of erythromycin lactobionate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Erythromycin stearate increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting its metabolism. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of erythromycin stearate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of estradiol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of synthetic conjugated estrogens by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of estropipate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of ethinyl estradiol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced. Use nonhormonal contraceptive methods. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of etonogestrel by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of etravirine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of everolimus by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of fedratinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. The impact of coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers has not been studied. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of felodipine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of fesoterodine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin increases the levels and effects of fexinidazole by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Fexinidazole inhibits CYP3A4, which may increase the risk of adverse effects for CYP3A4 substrates. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of finerenone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of fludrocortisone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of fosamprenavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Fosphenytoin decreases the levels and efficacy of rifabutin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of fostamatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of fruquintinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. If coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inducers is unavoidable, continue fruquintinib at the recommended dosage. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of ganaxolone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inducers. If unavoidable, consider increasing the ganaxolone dose, but do not exceed the maximum daily dose for weight. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of glasdegib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of hydrocortisone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of hydroxyprogesterone caproate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of ibrutinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong CYP3A4 inducers decrease ibrutinib plasma concentrations by approximately 10-fold. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of idelalisib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly reduce idelalisib systemic exposure. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of iloperidone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of indinavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Indinavir increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of infigratinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of irinotecan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of liposomal irinotecan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of istradefylline by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Itraconazole increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of ivabradine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of ivacaftor by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers, as systemic exposure to ivacaftor is substantially reduced (~9-fold). Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of ivosidenib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Ivosidenib decreases rifabutin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of ixabepilone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of ixazomib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers, as they decrease ixazomib Cmax by 54% and AUC by 74%. Ketoconazole increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of lapatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of larotrectinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers is unavoidable, double the larotrectinib dose. Resume the prior dose once the CYP3A4 inducer is discontinued for 3-5 half-lives. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of lefamulin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers unless the benefit outweighs the risks. Monitor for reduced efficacy. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of lemborexant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of lenacapavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of leniolisib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Levoketoconazole increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels and efficacy of lopinavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Lopinavir increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels and effects of loratadine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs.
